biocs.name: IMDS Access followed by Token Usage
biocs.description: Detection of process accessing IMDS followed by usage of retrieved credentials
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter action_remote_ip = '169.254.169.254'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != null
| filter action_remote_ip != null
| comp count() as cnt by causality_actor_process_image_name
| filter count() > 0
